​1. Coop System Operation & Maintenance (Closed/Open House)

​Ensure and monitor the performance of coop ventilation systems (exhaust fans/blowers, cooling pads, air intakes).

​Regulate and monitor ideal temperatures and humidity levels according to the target rearing phase (starter, grower, layer).

​Maintain and repair automatic feeding systems (chain feeders, pan feeders) as well as drinking systems (nipple drinkers).

​Ensure automatic or manual curtain systems function smoothly.

​2. Electrical & Generator Management

​Maintain, test, and prepare backup generators to operate automatically during power outages.

​Conduct routine checks on main electrical panels, coop lighting systems (duration and light intensity), and wiring networks.

​Maintain specialized lighting systems for photoperiodism control (egg-laying phase regulation).

​3. Plumbing & Water Supply Management

​Ensure water pumps, storage tanks, and pipelines function without leaks.

​Maintain water chlorination/medication dosing systems and perform pipeline flushing.

​4. Parent Stock Special Equipment Maintenance

​Maintain and ensure the smooth operation of automatic/manual nest box systems.

​Keep brooding heaters in a safe and ready-to-use condition during the initial brooding phase.

​Perform minor repairs on physical coop infrastructure (doors, partitions, roofs, and biosecurity fences).

​5. Biosecurity & Occupational Health and Safety (OHS / K3)

​Comply with all farm biosecurity regulations before, during, and after entering the coop area (biosecurity showers, tool sanitization).

​Periodically disinfect technical equipment brought into the coop area.

​Apply Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards when operating tools and electrical equipment.
